**Fahim Ahmed** is working as a Highway Safety Design Engineer with the **[South Carolina Department of Transportation (SCDOT)](https://www.scdot.org/)**. In his role in the Traffic Safety Office at SCDOT, he prepares Roadway Design Plans for Intersection Improvement Projects.
